title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・遠雷を聞きて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan fails to claim victory, she comes to a realization after experiencing such a ferocious race against Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Learning that she still has many rivals she wishes to surpass, and that racing with them will bring her opportunities to run with every ounce of her being…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan realizes that as long as she has rivals, her potential for growth will remain limitless. This epiphany leaves her unable to contain her excitement for our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Around this time, Sakura Chiyono O watches the autumn Tenno Sho on TV and sees Mejiro Ardan's growth as a racer with her own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan begins her preparation for the Osaka Hai. She remains entirely oblivious, however, to the shadow now cast over Sakura Chiyono O's face…
